situations.title: 수술 안전 문화 인지
situations.tagline: In this room, anyone can speak up if something doesn't seem right.
situations.brief: 수술장의 안전 문화를 이해하고 팀에 동참하세요.
keyPhrases: Anyone can raise a concern here.
Patient safety comes before speed.
We support each other in speaking up.

situations.title: 부위 표시 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the surgical site is marked before we go any further.
situations.brief: 수술 부위 표시가 되어 있는지 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Is the surgical site marked?
Let's confirm it matches the consent.
The mark is visible after draping.

situations.title: 타임아웃 참여
situations.tagline: Let's pause for the time-out and confirm the patient, site, and procedure together.
situations.brief: 타임아웃에 참여해 핵심 정보를 함께 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's do the time-out now.
Patient, procedure, and site—everyone agree?
Any concerns before we start?

situations.title: 계수 기본 참여
situations.tagline: Let's count the sponges and instruments together before we begin.
situations.brief: 기본 계수 과정에 참여해 함께 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's count the sponges and needles.
I'll count out loud with you.
The initial count is correct.

situations.title: 검체 라벨 확인
situations.tagline: Let's read the specimen label out loud and confirm it together.
situations.brief: 검체 라벨을 확인하는 기본 절차에 참여하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's read the specimen label together.
This is the right specimen and site?
I'll confirm before it leaves the room.

situations.title: 화재 위험 인지
situations.tagline: Let's be aware of the fire triangle in this room—oxygen, fuel, and the cautery.
situations.brief: 수술장 화재 위험 요소를 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's watch the fire triangle here.
Oxygen, prep alcohol, and cautery together are a risk.
Let the prep dry before we drape.

situations.title: speak-up 우려 표현
situations.tagline: I need to say something—I'm not comfortable moving on until we check this.
situations.brief: 우려되는 점을 speak-up로 명확히 표현하세요.
keyPhrases: I have a concern I need to raise.
Can we pause and double-check this?
I'm not comfortable proceeding yet.

situations.title: 계수 불일치 초기 대응
situations.tagline: The sponge count doesn't match—let's stop and recount before we close.
situations.brief: 계수 불일치 시 초기 대응 절차를 밟으세요.
keyPhrases: The count is off by one sponge.
Let's stop and recount together.
Please hold closure until we resolve this.

situations.title: 검체 처리 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm how each specimen is handled before it leaves the field.
situations.brief: 검체 처리 방식을 확인하고 대조하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the fixative and label.
Does this go to pathology or micro?
I'll document the handling and time.

situations.title: wrong-site 예방 재확인
situations.tagline: Before incision, let's re-verify the side one more time against the consent.
situations.brief: wrong-site 예방을 위해 부위를 재확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's re-verify the correct side.
The consent, mark, and imaging all agree?
I won't proceed until we all confirm.

situations.title: 화재 위험 사전 소통
situations.tagline: This case is high fire-risk—let's talk through our precautions before we start.
situations.brief: 화재 위험을 팀과 사전에 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a high fire-risk case.
Let's lower the oxygen and let prep dry.
Where's the saline and the extinguisher?

situations.title: 안전 체크리스트 준수
situations.tagline: Let's run through the surgical safety checklist, no steps skipped.
situations.brief: 수술 안전 체크리스트를 빠짐없이 준수하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's complete the full safety checklist.
We don't skip any item, even when busy.
Sign-in, time-out, and sign-out all done.

situations.title: 이식물·기기 안전 확인
situations.tagline: Let's confirm the implant and its details before it goes in.
situations.brief: 이식물과 기기의 안전 정보를 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's confirm the implant size and serial number.
Does it match the surgeon's request?
I'll document the implant details.

situations.title: 근접오류 보고
situations.tagline: That was a close call—let's report it as a near-miss so we can learn from it.
situations.brief: 근접오류를 보고해 재발을 예방하세요.
keyPhrases: That was a near-miss we should report.
Reporting it helps us prevent it next time.
I'll file the safety report today.

situations.title: 팀 안전 브리핑
situations.tagline: Let's do a quick team briefing so everyone knows the plan and the risks.
situations.brief: 팀 안전 브리핑으로 계획과 위험을 공유하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's brief the plan and key risks.
Any concerns before we begin?
Everyone knows their role and the backup plan.

situations.title: wrong-site 임박 저지
situations.tagline: Stop—that's the wrong side, we need to halt before the incision.
situations.brief: wrong-site 수술이 임박한 순간 즉시 저지하세요.
keyPhrases: Stop—this is the wrong side.
The consent says left, not right.
We halt now and re-verify everything.

situations.title: 이물 잔류 위기 대응
situations.tagline: The count is still short—we can't close until we find that missing item.
situations.brief: 이물 잔류 위기에 계수 확인과 수색으로 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: We're still missing one sponge.
We can't close until it's found.
Let's search the field and get an X-ray.

situations.title: 수술 화재 발생 대응
situations.tagline: There's a fire on the field—stop the oxygen and get saline on it now.
situations.brief: 수술 화재 발생 시 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Fire on the field—stop the oxygen.
Pour saline and remove burning material.
Get the extinguisher and call for help.

situations.title: 검체 분실 위기
situations.tagline: A specimen has gone missing—we have to stop and account for it immediately.
situations.brief: 검체 분실 위기에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: One specimen is unaccounted for.
Let's stop and search everywhere now.
I'm reporting this to pathology and the surgeon.

situations.title: 위해사건 즉시 보고
situations.tagline: This is an adverse event—we need to report it right away and preserve everything.
situations.brief: 위해사건을 즉시 보고하고 관련 물품을 보존하세요.
keyPhrases: This is an adverse event we must report.
Let's preserve the device and packaging.
I'll notify the charge nurse and file the report.

situations.title: 안전 위반 압력 저항
situations.tagline: I hear you, but I can't skip this safety step—patient safety comes first.
situations.brief: 안전 절차 생략 압력에 굴하지 않고 원칙을 지키세요.
keyPhrases: I can't skip this safety step.
I understand the pressure, but this protects the patient.
Let's take thirty seconds to do it right.
